owner_authorization: Owner requested full completion, online help where uncertain and reasonable assumptions. Retain current design; panel/screw exceedances deferred; actual build fit excluded.
material_assignment: Additional conditional numerical hypothesis that the modeled intact section has at least the declared C16 reference-strength envelope. This is not an observed grade assignment, a generic NDS DF-L No.2 capacity or a manufacturer qualification.
source_value_basis: Swedish Wood, Design of timber structures Volume 2, edition 3:2022, Table 3.3 p.10 (C16), p.11 (approximate rolling shear); p.25 gives a 0.67 crack-width factor for structural timber shear. Applying that reduction to the parallel-shear reference in this traction construction is an explicit conservative engineering choice, not an assertion that the entire construction is an EC5 procedure.
interaction_hypothesis: max(sigma/Ft,-sigma/Fc) + abs(tau_parallel)/Fv + abs(tau_rolling)/Fr <= 1. Positive linear interaction is an explicit engineering model, not a published complete connection fracture criterion.
reference_scaling_basis: Divide the declared base strengths by 2 for the working engineering reference; divisors 1.5 and 3 are sensitivities. No kmod, gammaM or NDS CD conversion is claimed. The source frame loads already include the recorded twice-bodyweight climber scenario. Uniform whole-wrench magnification 1.5 is a separate sensitivity, not an authenticated Eurocode ULS combination or a proven physical demand bound.
fracture_scope: General EN338 transverse tensile strength does not supply complete perpendicular-loaded connection resistance (COST connection report p155). The intact-section field leaves bore concentration, crack initiation/propagation, three-dimensional elastic compatibility and complete cleat resistance separate.
